mapper.sql: FROM QUERY_REQUEST R JOIN USERS DRAFTER ON DRAFTER.USER_ID = R.DRAFTER_ID JOIN DEPARTMENT REQUEST_DEPT ON REQUEST_DEPT.DEPT_ID = R.DEPT_ID

R.SUBMITTED_AT IS NOT NULL AND R.REQUEST_STATUS <> 'DRAFT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USERS ACTOR JOIN DEPARTMENT ACTOR_DEPT ON ACTOR_DEPT.DEPT_ID = ACTOR.DEPT_ID WHERE ACTOR.USER_ID = #{actorId} AND ACTOR.ENABLED = 'Y' AND ( R.DEPT_ID = ACTOR.DEPT_ID OR ( ACTOR_DEPT.DEPT_NAME = 'DB팀' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USER_ROLE UR JOIN ROLE RL ON RL.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE UR.USER_ID = ACTOR.USER_ID AND RL.ROLE_CODE IN ( 'DB_APPROVER', 'DB_ADMIN' ) ) ) ) )

sql.if: AND ( INSTR(UPPER(R.REQUEST_NO), UPPER(#{keyword})) > 0 OR INSTR(UPPER(R.TITLE), UPPER(#{keyword})) > 0 OR INSTR( UPPER(DRAFTER.USER_NAME), UPPER(#{keyword}) ) > 0 OR INSTR( UPPER(REQUEST_DEPT.DEPT_NAME), UPPER(#{keyword}) ) > 0 )

mapper.select:
SELECT R.REQUEST_ID, R.REQUEST_NO, R.REQUEST_TYPE, R.TITLE, R.IS_URGENT, R.REQUEST_CLASS, R.REQUEST_STATUS, R.APPROVAL_STATUS, R.CREATED_AT, R.DESIRED_DATE, R.SUBMITTED_AT, DRAFTER.USER_NAME AS DRAFTER_NAME, REQUEST_DEPT.DEPT_NAME, CASE WHEN R.REQUEST_TYPE = 'CREATE_VIEW' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM VIEW_CREATE_SQL V WHERE V.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID) ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM QUERY_ITEM I WHERE I.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID) END AS SQL_COUNT, CASE WHEN R.REQUEST_TYPE = 'CREATE_VIEW' AND R.REQUEST_STATUS = 'READY' AND R.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN NVL((SELECT VR.RESULT_STATUS FROM VIEW_CREATE_RESULT VR WHERE VR.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID), 'PENDING') ELSE NULL END AS VIEW_RESULT_STATUS
WHERE
ORDER BY R.SUBMITTED_AT DESC, R.REQUEST_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT R.REQUEST_ID, R.REQUEST_NO, R.REQUEST_TYPE, R.TITLE, R.PURPOSE, R.DETAIL_CONTENT, R.IS_URGENT, R.DESIRED_DATE, DRAFTER.USER_NAME AS DRAFTER_NAME, REQUEST_DEPT.DEPT_NAME, R.REQUEST_CLASS, R.REQUEST_STATUS, R.APPROVAL_STATUS, R.CREATED_AT, R.SUBMITTED_AT
WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND

SELECT I.QUERY_ID, I.QUERY_ORDER, I.QUERY_TITLE, I.SQL_TEXT, I.AUTHORING_TYPE, I.VALIDATION_STATUS, I.ITEM_CLASS
JOIN QUERY_ITEM I ON I.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND ORDER BY I.QUERY_ORDER, I.QUERY_ID

SELECT V.QUERY_ID, V.QUERY_ORDER, V.SQL_TITLE AS QUERY_TITLE, V.SQL_CONTENT AS SQL_TEXT FROM VIEW_CREATE_SQL V JOIN QUERY_REQUEST R ON R.REQUEST_ID = V.REQUEST_ID JOIN USERS DRAFTER ON DRAFTER.USER_ID = R.DRAFTER_ID JOIN DEPARTMENT REQUEST_DEPT ON REQUEST_DEPT.DEPT_ID = R.DEPT_ID WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND R.REQUEST_TYPE = 'CREATE_VIEW' AND ORDER BY V.QUERY_ORDER, V.QUERY_ID

SELECT A.APPROVAL_ID, A.APPROVAL_ORDER, A.APPROVAL_TYPE, A.STATUS, A.APPROVER_ID, APPROVER.USER_NAME AS APPROVER_NAME, APPROVER_DEPT.DEPT_NAME, P.POSITION_NAME
JOIN APPROVAL A ON A.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID LEFT JOIN USERS APPROVER ON APPROVER.USER_ID = A.APPROVER_ID LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT APPROVER_DEPT ON APPROVER_DEPT.DEPT_ID = APPROVER.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN POSITION P ON P.POSITION_ID = APPROVER.POSITION_ID WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND ORDER BY A.APPROVAL_ORDER, A.APPROVAL_ID

SELECT A.APPROVAL_ORDER, A.APPROVAL_TYPE, A.APPROVER_ID, APPROVER.USER_NAME AS APPROVER_NAME, APPROVER_DEPT.DEPT_NAME, P.POSITION_NAME, A.STATUS, A.COMMENT_TEXT, A.CREATED_AT, A.DECIDED_AT
JOIN APPROVAL A ON A.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID LEFT JOIN USERS APPROVER ON APPROVER.USER_ID = A.APPROVER_ID LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT APPROVER_DEPT ON APPROVER_DEPT.DEPT_ID = APPROVER.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN POSITION P ON P.POSITION_ID = APPROVER.POSITION_ID WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND ORDER BY A.APPROVAL_ORDER, A.APPROVAL_ID

SELECT VR.RESULT_STATUS, VR.RESULT_CONTENT, U.USER_NAME AS REGISTERED_BY_NAME, VR.REGISTERED_AT FROM VIEW_CREATE_RESULT VR JOIN QUERY_REQUEST R ON R.REQUEST_ID = VR.REQUEST_ID JOIN USERS DRAFTER ON DRAFTER.USER_ID = R.DRAFTER_ID JOIN DEPARTMENT REQUEST_DEPT ON REQUEST_DEPT.DEPT_ID = R.DEPT_ID JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = VR.REGISTERED_BY WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND R.REQUEST_TYPE = 'CREATE_VIEW' AND

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM QUERY_REQUEST R WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND R.REQUEST_TYPE = 'CREATE_VIEW' AND R.REQUEST_STATUS = 'READY' AND R.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USERS U JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID JOIN USER_ROLE UR ON UR.USER_ID = U.USER_ID JOIN ROLE RL ON RL.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE U.USER_ID = #{actorId} AND U.ENABLED = 'Y' AND D.DEPT_NAME = 'DB팀' AND RL.ROLE_CODE IN ('DB_APPROVER', 'DB_ADMIN') )
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO VIEW_CREATE_RESULT T USING (SELECT #{requestId} AS REQUEST_ID FROM DUAL) S ON (T.REQUEST_ID = S.REQUEST_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.RESULT_STATUS = #{resultStatus}, T.RESULT_CONTENT = #{resultContent, jdbcType=CLOB}, T.REGISTERED_BY = #{actorId}, T.REGISTERED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, T.UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( REQUEST_ID, RESULT_STATUS, RESULT_CONTENT, REGISTERED_BY, REGISTERED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( S.REQUEST_ID, #{resultStatus}, #{resultContent, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{actorId}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )
